common_name: Water-Lily Quinaria-Group Fly (Longitudinal Wing Vein & Crossvein Melanin Shading)

scale.anatomical_structure: Turing pigment stripe / ocellus wavelength in Drosophila deflecta (2.6 µm, detail scale)

evolutionary_history.note: All three chronospecies are extant (0 Ma). The difference at this tier is the selected wavenumber, not a stratigraphic transition. D. deflecta is taxonomically a quinaria-group fly; the radiation name is the assigned chronoseries bucket.

state_variables.u: activator (short-range vein-melanin precursor; Wingless-like effective field)

boundary_conditions: Neumann zero-flux on a square epithelial patch whose side is 12 analytical wavelengths (~31.6 µm). The reported phenomenon is the wavelength, not the patch size.

equations.kinetics: du/dt = (a - u + u^2 v) + D_u laplacian(u); dv/dt = (b - u^2 v) + D_v laplacian(v)
equations.dispersion: det(J - k^2 D) = D_u D_v k^4 - (D_v f_u + D_u g_v) k^2 + (f_u g_v - f_v g_u)
equations.critical_wavenumber: k_c^2 = (D_v f_u + D_u g_v) / (2 D_u D_v); lambda_c = 2 pi / k_c
equations.forcing_pass2: du/dt gains kappa(t) (m(x) - u), where m is the segmented specimen luminance mapped into the activator range

parameters.length_unit: chosen so analytical lambda_c equals 2.633e-06 m

empirical_claims: Turing (1952) gives the diffusion-driven instability and the critical wavenumber; Schnakenberg (1979) supplies the two-species kinetics used here.

Werner et al. (2010) showed that Wingless at vein intersections paints polka-dot spots in D. guttifera. That is the nearest vein-associated pigmentation mechanism for a quinaria-group wing. It was not measured at 2.633 µm in D. deflecta.
Prud'homme et al. (2006) showed that the D. elegans male apical wing spot evolved by cis-regulatory changes at yellow. That spot is the successor morphology in this chronoseries.

The gallery tile used as the specimen is a sepia spiral ocellus. Pass 2 asks the forced Schnakenberg field to track that image. The pure, unforced field is a stripe/spot pattern at lambda_c and is not a pixel copy of the tile.

specimen.license_note: Project gallery fallback. Wikimedia Commons query for Drosophila deflecta returned no CC still photograph.
specimen.gallery_scale_bar: 100 µm drawn on the tile; modeled phenomenon scale remains 2.633 µm

does_not_claim: Does not claim a wet-lab measurement of a 2.633 µm Turing wavelength on a D. deflecta wing.
Does not claim D. deflecta belongs phylogenetically to the virilis–repleta–guttifera radiation.
Does not claim the unforced Schnakenberg field reproduces the gallery spiral phase.
